the-general.title: The General
the-general.tagline: He loves two things: his train and his girl.
the-general.description: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, a Southern train engineer chases it deep behind enemy lines in one of the great chase comedies.
the-general.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Clyde Bruckman · Starring Buster Keaton · Marion Mack

sherlock-jr.title: Sherlock Jr.
sherlock-jr.tagline: A projectionist dreams his way into the movies.
sherlock-jr.description: A small-town projectionist who dreams of being a detective falls asleep on the job and walks straight into the movie on screen.
sherlock-jr.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Starring Buster Keaton · Kathryn McGuire · Joe Keaton

safety-last.title: Safety Last!
safety-last.tagline: One man. Twelve stories. No net.
safety-last.description: A small-town go-getter promises his sweetheart he has made it big in the city, then has to climb the outside of a skyscraper to prove it.
safety-last.credits: Directed by Fred C. Newmeyer · Sam Taylor · Starring Harold Lloyd · Mildred Davis

the-freshman.title: The Freshman
the-freshman.tagline: The most popular man on campus — in his own mind.
the-freshman.description: An eager college newcomer tries to become the most popular man on campus and ends up the tackling dummy of the football team.
the-freshman.credits: Directed by Fred C. Newmeyer · Sam Taylor · Starring Harold Lloyd · Jobyna Ralston

one-week.title: One Week
one-week.tagline: Newlyweds. A build-it-yourself house. What could go wrong?
one-week.description: Newlyweds try to assemble a build-it-yourself house in seven days, not knowing a jealous rival has swapped the numbers on the boxes.
one-week.credits: Directed by Buster Keaton · Edward F. Cline · Starring Buster Keaton · Sybil Seely

his-girl-friday.title: His Girl Friday
his-girl-friday.description: A fast-talking newspaper editor schemes to stop his star reporter, who is also his ex-wife, from quitting and remarrying by handing her one last big story.
his-girl-friday.credits: Directed by Howard Hawks · Starring Cary Grant · Rosalind Russell · Ralph Bellamy

nosferatu.title: Nosferatu
nosferatu.tagline: The original vampire. Still the scariest.
nosferatu.description: A real-estate clerk travels to the Carpathians to close a sale with the reclusive Count, who then follows him home bringing plague and death.
nosferatu.credits: Directed by F. W. Murnau · Starring Max Schreck · Gustav von Wangenheim · Greta Schröder

phantom-of-the-opera.title: The Phantom of the Opera
phantom-of-the-opera.tagline: Beneath the opera house, someone is listening.
phantom-of-the-opera.description: A disfigured genius haunting the cellars beneath the Paris Opera grooms a young singer for stardom, and will kill anyone who stands in his way.
phantom-of-the-opera.credits: Directed by Rupert Julian · Starring Lon Chaney · Mary Philbin · Norman Kerry

night-of-the-living-dead.title: Night of the Living Dead
night-of-the-living-dead.description: Strangers barricade themselves inside a Pennsylvania farmhouse as the recently dead rise and close in through the night.
night-of-the-living-dead.credits: Directed by George A. Romero · Starring Duane Jones · Judith O'Dea · Karl Hardman

the-little-shop-of-horrors.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
the-little-shop-of-horrors.description: A hapless florist's assistant breeds a strange plant that makes the shop famous, but it only thrives on human blood.
the-little-shop-of-horrors.credits: Directed by Roger Corman · Starring Jonathan Haze · Jackie Joseph · Mel Welles

carnival-of-souls.title: Carnival of Souls
carnival-of-souls.tagline: She walked away from the crash. Or did she?
carnival-of-souls.description: After surviving a car crash into a river, a church organist starts a new life in Utah but is stalked by a ghoulish figure and drawn to an abandoned pavilion.
carnival-of-souls.credits: Directed by Herk Harvey · Starring Candace Hilligoss · Sidney Berger · Frances Feist

metropolis.title: Metropolis
metropolis.tagline: The city of the future was built in 1927.
metropolis.description: In a towering future city split between idle rulers and underground workers, the ruler's son falls for a prophet of the workers, and an inventor builds a robot in her image.
metropolis.credits: Directed by Fritz Lang · Starring Brigitte Helm · Gustav Fröhlich · Alfred Abel

a-trip-to-the-moon.title: A Trip to the Moon
a-trip-to-the-moon.tagline: The first science-fiction film ever made.
a-trip-to-the-moon.description: A congress of astronomers fires itself to the moon in a giant shell, lands in the Man in the Moon's eye, and escapes the moon's strange inhabitants.
a-trip-to-the-moon.credits: Directed by Georges Méliès · Starring Georges Méliès · Bleuette Bernon

all-quiet-on-the-western-front.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
all-quiet-on-the-western-front.tagline: Young men, sold a glorious war.
all-quiet-on-the-western-front.description: A class of German schoolboys enlists in the First World War full of patriotic fire and learns in the trenches what the war really costs.
all-quiet-on-the-western-front.credits: Directed by Lewis Milestone · Starring Lew Ayres · Louis Wolheim · John Wray

d-o-a.title: D.O.A.
d-o-a.tagline: A man reports his own murder.
d-o-a.description: A small-town accountant learns he has been fatally poisoned and has only days left to find out who killed him, and why.
d-o-a.credits: Directed by Rudolph Maté · Starring Edmond O'Brien · Pamela Britton · Luther Adler

man-with-a-movie-camera.title: Man with a Movie Camera
man-with-a-movie-camera.tagline: One day in the life of a city, told only in pictures.
man-with-a-movie-camera.description: A cameraman roams Soviet cities from dawn to dusk in a wordless, restlessly inventive portrait of modern life and of filmmaking itself.
man-with-a-movie-camera.credits: Directed by Dziga Vertov · Edited by Elizaveta Svilova · Starring Mikhail Kaufman

big-buck-bunny.title: Big Buck Bunny
big-buck-bunny.tagline: A gentle giant. Three very rude rodents.
big-buck-bunny.description: A gentle giant rabbit's sunny day is ruined by three bullying rodents, so he plans an elaborate cartoon revenge.
big-buck-bunny.credits: Directed by Sacha Goedegebure · Produced by Blender Foundation
